products.title: Starvie Junior 2025 - Star Vie
products.description:
STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 - Starvie's junior racket, for children who are starting out in this sport. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Are you looking for a junior racket? The STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 is one of the alternatives we have for the little ones. Quality alternative, very comfortable and light weight.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for a child who is starting to play.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The STARVIE JUNIOR 2025 has the following characteristics:

- Round shape. It ensures low balance and good mobility.

- Low weight. Its weight is around 330 grams.

- Made of fiberglass.

- Xtreme Spot technology that increases the sweet spot.

PLAY STYLE

It is a wing with a lot of control, ideal for learning correctly in the first steps in this wonderful sport.

products.title: Vibora Yarara Pro Silver 2026 - Vibor-a
products.description:
VIBORA YARARA PRO SILVER 2026 - The renewed Yarara Pro. A magnificent, light, complete racket. Without a doubt one of the most complete models on the market. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The VIBORA YARARA PRO SILVER 2026 is Vibora's new jewel for 2026. New racket with a dark silver aesthetic, very elegant and beautiful. In hybrid form it has a super extensive sweet spot.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a high-performance racket created for professional players looking for a perfect balance between power, control and precision in each stroke.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The characteristics of the VIBORA YARARA PRO SILVER 2026 are:

- hybrid format, very effective to maximize the sweet spot.

- Expanded perforation, for a better hitting sensation and therefore more control.

- 12K carbon fiber as the main protagonist throughout the blade.

- Its professional EVA rubber core provides a reactive but comfortable touch, adapted to those looking for performance without giving up the feeling of play.

- One of its key points is the reinforced bridge, which not only reduces vibrations, but also improves the overall balance of the racket, making each movement more stable and safe.

products.title: Paletero Black Crown Plus Gris Naranja - Black Crown
products.description:
BLACK CROWN PLUS GRAY ORANGE PADEL BAG - With its central opening with double zipper and velcro system, it is a padel bag with large interior space and a unique design. With the new BLACK CROWN PLUS GRAY ORANGE PADEL BAG you will have space for everything. It has a large central compartment in which we find a double zipper opening, a touch that differentiates it and gives it an improvement in design superior to the rest, in addition to increasing its loading opening.

On the side, it has a compartment with thermal protection, whose objective is to protect the blades inside, whatever the weather is outside. In this, we can put up to two paddle tennis rackets.

On the other hand, we cannot forget the compartment for paddle shoes and its two side pockets for other types of objects that we want to store in them.

It is great for everyone and even for competitive players who want to have everything well organized.
